About Me

Shaping Sustainable
Urban Futures

I am MD. Toufiq Hossain, an Urban Planner and Researcher holding a Bachelor's degree from Rajshahi University of Engineering and Technology (RUET), where I ranked 9th in my class (Out of 56) with a CGPA of 3.58/4.00 and received a merit-based technical scholarship in the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th academic years from the URP Department.

I am currently working as Assistant Urban Planner at Sheltech Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., where I contribute to Upazila and Paurashava Master plans, Transportation Planning GIS-based spatial analysis, environmental mapping, and community engagement research.

My research spans land use dynamics, biodiversity, transportation, disaster risk assessment, community-based tourism, economic regionalization — with publications in Springer, Journal of Bangladesh Institute of Planners and multiple conferences, along with submitted and peer-reviewed journal manuscripts in Environmental Science Europe and International Journal of Community Well-Being.
